scope_boundaries: Already admitted/exposed complete contexts only, nominated prospectively by root. No target body or image inspected by producer.

title: RAW UNREVIEWED: assay acceptance sign releases an existing batch without creating a new product
summary: A technical paragraph may sample an existing batch, test a property, then accept or reject it by an observed sign. A repeated quality-like construction concerns the tested batch and a separate sample, not another recipe stage or automatically achieved transformation. Image-owned vessels constrain sample versus stored-batch roles.
required_falsifier: Reject if the observation becomes a material output, if a sample supplies no provenance, if acceptance lacks a written criterion, or a fixed wholeform construction cannot distinguish result-state from decision in every nominated context.
exact_changed_research_decision: Choose a batch-assessment whole reading versus manufacture only if an explicit criterion and existing-batch identity survive the whole text; this does not certify any material identity or inherited quality axis.

design.mechanism: Enter batch B; TAKE_SAMPLE(S,B) preserves provenance; TEST(S,P) yields written observation O; criterion C(O) licenses ACCEPT(B) or REJECT(B). Acceptance is a decision on B, not manufacture of output O. Each written component pays one role and wholeform variants distinguish observation from decision.
independent_constraints: Written sampling provenance links a physically distinct sample to an existing batch.
A complete historical assay passage distinguishes observed criterion from material transformation.
Independent image vessel ownership and wholeform/neighbour profiles distinguish sample/test/release roles without substance-name guessing.
design.unit: Two complete prospective admitted contexts plus their independently owned image-role evidence; no target nomination or access by producer.
design.minimum_adequate_test: First audit claim-bearing predecessors and known counterexample; then root can choose one paired exploratory whole reading and only freeze a test if a distinct consequence remains.
design.budget_note: Root must set total preparation/implementation/validation/publication budget in the selected existing proposal before substantial work; this raw producer launches no experiment.

duplicate_navigation.important_limit: No identity reported by navigation is not proof of novelty. Raw refinement may overlap its named predecessors; root must check claim-bearing primaries before selection.
